parameters.formDescription: Control de borrador de DJ IVA Simple

parameters.text:
Extract the following information from this Argentine IVA tax document and return ONLY a valid JSON object with no additional text:

{
  "periodo": "",
  "totalDebitoFiscal": 0,
  "totalCreditoFiscal": 0,
  "saldoTecnicoContribuyentePeriodoAnterior": 0,
  "saldoTecnicoARCA_Determinacion": 0,
  "saldoTecnicoARCA_Posicion": 0,
  "saldoLibreDisponibilidad": 0,
  "totalRetencionesPercepcionesPagos": 0,
  "saldoImpuestoARCA": 0
}

Rules:
- Convert all currency values to numbers (remove $, spaces, dots for thousands)
- Replace comma with dot for decimals
- Extract periodo in format MM/YYYY from "PERÍODO" field
- Return ONLY the JSON object, no markdown, no explanation
